ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast binary distribution; approximately 85% high-intensity white interior pixels vs 15% low-intensity black pixels localized on the perimeter and notch region.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary contiguous high-intensity white region across 80% of both fluke lobes; low-intensity black pigmentation mapping concentrated along the trailing edges, the medial notch region, and the distal tips; three distinct vertical black streaks on the inner-left lobe proximal to the notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression; acute angle estimated at approximately 40-45 degrees with high depth-to-width ratio relative to the lobe base.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serrations on the distal portion of the left lobe; low-frequency, low-amplitude scalloping along the right trailing edge; visible jagged fragmentation on the far left terminal edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex curve on the leading edges; the trailing edges exhibit a slight terminal convexity transitioning to a straight/concave sweep towards the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of circular dark spots on the far-left fluke tip; smaller circular depressions/marks visible on the far-right fluke tip area.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of three distinct, near-vertical dark linear streaks on the ventral surface of the left lobe, centered between the notch and the mid-lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular serration and potential tissue loss on the distal edge of the left lobe compared to the more uniform right lobe; distinct black markings/lesions concentrated around the fluke notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a physical data card in the lower frame containing metadata: JAC91-41/14, ID 10002, S# A17, 10 Oct 91, and the handwritten name 'Diego'.
